question: What is the primary purpose of referencing in academic nursing papers?

options.A: Fulfilling strict formatting rules without any real value
options.B: Acknowledging the original authors of borrowed ideas
options.C: Making the research paper look longer and detailed
options.D: Proving that the writer read a large volume of books

explanation: Referencing gives credit to original creators and prevents intellectual theft. [learn more](GNS217_U3_T7#GNS217_U3_T7_h1)

question: Why must nursing students trace clinical claims back to original research?

options.A: To verify the accuracy of evidence-based interventions
options.B: To avoid reading textbooks published in past decades
options.C: To replace actual clinical practice hours with reading
options.D: To satisfy the personal preferences of strict lecturers

explanation: Tracing sources ensures that patient care relies on accurate, verified scientific evidence. [learn more](GNS217_U3_T7#GNS217_U3_T7_h1)

question: Presenting another person's work or ideas as your own is called what?
explanation: Using someone else's intellectual property without proper credit is the definition of plagiarism. [learn more](GNS217_U3_T7#GNS217_U3_T7_h2)

question: How does academic integrity directly relate to the professional nursing code of ethics?

options.A: It only applies to university assignments and not hospital wards
options.B: Honesty in research mirrors honesty and accountability in patient care
options.C: Ethical codes focus strictly on medication administration safety
options.D: Writing integrity is entirely separate from clinical nursing duties

explanation: The same ethical values of honesty and trust required in clinical practice apply to academic writing. [learn more](GNS217_U3_T7#GNS217_U3_T7_h2)

question: Where do in-text citations appear within a nursing research paper?

options.A: Inside the footnotes at the bottom of the title page
options.B: On a separate dedication page before the abstract
options.C: Inside the body paragraphs near the borrowed information
options.D: At the very end of the entire manuscript

explanation: In-text citations are placed directly inside the text next to the referenced ideas. [learn more](GNS217_U3_T7#GNS217_U3_T7_h3)

question: What information does a reference list provide that in-text citations omit?

options.A: The personal opinions of the student writing the paper
options.B: Brief page numbers for every quote used in the introduction
options.C: Full publication details like publisher names and journal volumes
options.D: A summary of every single textbook stored in the library

explanation: The reference list gives complete bibliographic details so anyone can retrieve the original material. [learn more](GNS217_U3_T7#GNS217_U3_T7_h3)

question: Which referencing style uses numeric superscripts inside the text for citations?
explanation: The Vancouver system relies on numbers in brackets or superscripts corresponding to the reference list. [learn more](GNS217_U3_T7#GNS217_U3_T7_h4)

question: Why are specific referencing styles required by nursing departments?

options.A: To prevent foreign authors from reading local Nigerian journals
options.B: To ensure all books have the exact same number of pages
options.C: To maintain consistency and easy readability across professional publications
options.D: To make research writing unnecessarily complicated for students

explanation: Standardized styles allow researchers worldwide to read and format scholarly work uniformly. [learn more](GNS217_U3_T7#GNS217_U3_T7_h4)

question: What elements are included in a basic APA in-text citation for a book?

options.B: Author's last name and publication year
options.C: Full book title and page numbers

explanation: APA in-text citations typically require only the author's surname and the year of publication. [learn more](GNS217_U3_T7#GNS217_U3_T7_h5)

question: A nursing student writes: (Adeleke, 2023). What formatting style does this represent?
explanation: Author-date citations enclosed in parentheses are characteristic of APA and Harvard styles. [learn more](GNS217_U3_T7#GNS217_U3_T7_h5)

question: Which of the following tools helps students organize references and generate citations?
explanation: Mendeley is a popular reference management tool used by researchers to store and cite sources. [learn more](GNS217_U3_T7#GNS217_U3_T7_h6)

question: Why should nursing students manually check citations generated by software programs?

options.A: Reference managers delete citations after thirty days of use
options.B: Lecturers prefer hand-written bibliographies over digital lists
options.C: Computers are entirely incapable of formatting references correctly
options.D: Software can make mistakes if database entries have errors

explanation: Automated tools rely on user-inputted metadata, which frequently contains capitalization or spelling mistakes. [learn more](GNS217_U3_T7#GNS217_U3_T7_h6)
